units: R = % of the account at a 1 % base stake, no compounding (ideal account); account runs in % of the account

selection.rule: scale each configuration to the reference's worst week; eligible if scaled max drawdown <= reference's; highest share of winning weeks; tie: highest scaled total. View: gross, common period 2018-02..2021-12.
selection.soft_rule: same rule among the configurations that keep >= 2/3 of the reference's total after scaling
